This is the unmodified post-burn coast save from the 62.5 ms SPS-3 flight in
[NASSP CI run 44408490032](https://github.com/dcajacob/NASSP/actions/runs/44408490032).
It came from `native-linux-opengl-apollo7-sps3-scs-burn-rate-mode-results`
at `flight/runtime-release-apollo7-countdown-sps3-scs-burn-rate-mode/followon/saved.scn`.

At GET 276165.9375 seconds, AS-205 is in Earth orbit with the CMC in P00 and
3548.921 kg of SPS propellant. The SHA-256 of the complete save is
`b6da432e88ece2a8722d7be0be81434153f345ea6e1c5606161bb8cb334737c3`.
